policy.boundary_description: Disposable local engineering validation in the inherited OS sandbox; agent workspaces are controller-created private repository copies; network disabled.

source.purpose: one bounded Luna-medium main-chat controller acceptance exercise

tasks.hypothesis: The comma parser drops the first token before reduction.
tasks.experiment: Run the actual parse_values("2,3") and compare its ordered list to [2,3], plus matched singleton and whitespace cases.
tasks.prompt: Inspect source read-only. Execute actual parse_values on matched text inputs including "2,3", "7", and " 2 , , 3 ". Compare parsed lists to expected parsed values. Preserve exact outputs, command evidence and uncertainty; do not infer reducer correctness from parser results.

tasks.hypothesis: The reducer independently omits the first parsed value.
tasks.experiment: Create a temporary Python wrapper inside declared scratch/, compile it into scratch/, import actual totals.py, and compare aggregate([2,3]), aggregate([7]), aggregate([]), and total("2,3") against built-in sum or expected results.
allowed_commands: Create/compile/run one bounded Python wrapper only in scratch/ against actual module
tasks.prompt: Read production files only. Under your declared scratch/ scope create a temporary Python wrapper that imports actual totals.py, compile it to bytecode within scratch/, and run it. Compare aggregate([2,3]), aggregate([7]), aggregate([]), and total("2,3") to sum/expected outputs. No production edits. Report literal stdout, command execution and scope.

tasks.hypothesis: The observed first-item omission is stable across repeated calls and is not transient input state.
tasks.experiment: Using actual total() on matched repeated inputs before and after exactly one bounded 60-second sleep, compare results to expected sums; do not sleep again.
allowed_commands: Run repeated actual calls and exactly one time.sleep(60)
tasks.prompt: Inspect production source read-only. Perform a baseline actual total("2,3") call, exactly one time.sleep(60), then repeat total("2,3") and total("-4,9,-2"). Do not sleep again. Preserve command/output and distinguish a reproduced failure from interruption/setup failure.

Correct the actual reducer defect so all parsed values contribute. Preserve parse behavior and every unchanged assertion. Run python3 -B -m unittest -v; include observed command evidence and changed paths.
acceptance_checks: all existing unittest assertions pass unchanged
